notes: §1985:XIII.3.20.4 GR10 orders a control footing's processing minor to major: a) crossfoot ("all sum counters defined in this report group that are operands of SUM clauses in the same report group are added to their sum counters"), b) roll forward, c) the USE BEFORE REPORTING procedure, d)/e) present unless SUPPRESSed or not printable, f) reset, step f running even for a RESET control with no footing. ProcessControlFootings walks the levels from minor up to the break level and resets ResetLevel counters for footings declared or not; BeginGroup applies the group's own sum arithmetic (ApplyRolled crossFoot: true, crossfoot and roll forward) before RunBeforeReporting, then presents or skips to EndOfGroupSumReset; ReportSectionBinder.RolledRepetitionFault admits the non-repeating same-group crossfoot below 2002. Probes at --std 85 (classes b,c,d): CONTROLS FINAL MAJ MIN, signed values with -4: CF MIN USE sees S1 3, crossfoot XS 6 and the FINAL roll F1 already 6; SUPPRESS in the second USE leaves that line unprinted but F1 reaches 12 and LINE-COUNTER stays 4; a nonprintable CF MAJ runs after CF MIN with T1 6; R1 SUM RESET ON MAJ with no printable MAJ footing restarts (1 after the break); finals 014 010 007. At --std 2023 the same XS SUM S1 S2 is refused COBOL2730 (§2023:13.18.54.3 SR4 b)). The witness checks crossfoot, roll forward and USE timing.

next.reason: Most steps are kept. Order of footings: §2023:13.18.57.4 GR6 e)1 'in order of controls from the lowest up to the level of the control break', §2023:14.9.16.4 GR5, §2023:14.9.46.4 GR3 b). Rolling forward (1985 b): §2023:13.18.54.4 GR7 a) 'adding takes place when the report group description containing data-name-1 is processed', and §2023:13.18.54.4 GR6 completes an addend's own additions first, so 1985's crossfoot-before-rollforward order survives. USE after summing (1985 c): §2023:14.9.49.4 GR9 b) 'After incrementing sum counters defined in the report group'. SUPPRESS/not printable (1985 d, e): §2023:14.9.45.4 GR3 and §2023:8.4.3.15.4 GR5 (dummy or suppressed group leaves the counters alone). Reset, including RESET on a control with no footing (1985 f and its preamble): §2023:13.18.54.4 GR2 'If no such control footing is defined, it is assumed to be present'. The difference is step a, crossfooting 'all sum counters defined in this report group that are operands of SUM clauses in the same report group': §2023:13.18.54.3 SR4 b) 'If data-name-1 is specified in the same report group description as the subject of the entry, data-name-1 shall be a repeating item' with an extra level of repetition, so a 1985 crossfoot of non-repeating sum counters is rejected at compile time in 2023.
